title: Greenhouse handbook
text:
A synthetic handbook of a greenhouse that does not exist.

# Watering

Tomatoes are watered at nine and at six.
Peppers are watered at nine only.

## Water source

The rain barrel first; the tap when it is empty.

## Полив зимой

Зимой поливаем только утром, тёплой водой.
Вода из крана должна постоять сутки.

# Tools

```
hose: 10 m
# not a heading
bucket: 2
```

# Journal

Every watering goes into the journal.
